data.content_ref: inline:The extracted_episodes.json (SRC_005) depends on review_ledger.json (SRC_002) as its adjudication substrate: SRC_005 encodes episode-level outcomes and decision records whose validity is determined by the review ledger's accepted/rejected verdicts. Refuted if the episode records in SRC_005 can be shown to have been generated independently of, or prior to, any review-ledger verdicts, such that no episode's outcome depends on a SRC_002 review decision.
